desc:
🏴‍☠️ Fix up a rusty pirate boat, grab your crew and survive a risky voyage across the open sea!

⚓ BUILD your skiff with engines, guns and upgrades
🏝️ EXPLORE new islands every run and loot treasure
💰 SELL loot at outposts and reach the final port
⚔️ FIGHT raiders, capture boats, hijack the cargo ship
🦈 SURVIVE sharks, storms, mines... and the KRAKEN!
👥 PLAY with up to 6 friends, or solo
🎨 UNLOCK skins, hats and outfits, and get Most Wanted

Go home rich, or lose it all at sea! 🌊

📌 Disclaimer: An original cartoon adventure on a made-up coast. All places, ships and crews are invented and not based on any real country, group or event; it isn’t Somalia. Crews of every look sail on both sides. Racism, hate or bullying in chat gets you banned. This game is independently developed and protected by law; false claims or takedowns will be challenged. Be kind and have fun! 🏴‍☠️
